name: Psychic Blades
desc: Whenever you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a Psychic Blade (Simple Melee weapon, Finesse and Thrown, normal range 60 feet, Vex mastery): 1d6 Psychic damage + the ability modifier used for the attack. After attacking with it, you can make another attack with a second blade as a Bonus Action on the same turn (1d4 Psychic damage + the ability modifier). The blade vanishes right after it hits or misses and leaves no mark.
